public_rationale: OpenAI's disclosure, available by January 22, 2026, describes Deep Research use and higher adoption of advanced features among technical users, while calling advanced features underused [e1]. It provides no Deep Research usage totals, measurement period or repeat-use figures establishing sustained large-scale use [e1]. It also provides no evidence of permanent discontinuation with negligible lifetime use, leaving the forecast unresolved [e1].
limitations: The disclosure does not quantify Deep Research's absolute scale or frequency of use.
Relative underuse of advanced features does not establish negligible Deep Research use.
The claim supplies no numerical threshold or deadline.

our_interpretation: Heavy use means substantial, repeated use of OpenAI's Deep Research across users, beyond launch demonstrations or access being offered.
The claim supplies neither a numerical threshold nor a deadline. I do not substitute overall ChatGPT adoption for use of this feature.
criteria.support_condition: Dated, feature-specific usage measurements clearly establish sustained large-scale use.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Permanent discontinuation, accompanied by sufficiently complete lifetime usage evidence showing negligible use.
